description: Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. The optional journey_token is a server-issued correlation value linking lookups and a later inquiry in the same customer conversation. Omission starts a new lookup journey. Save a customer-confirmed quote, sample or supply-feasibility inquiry (not an order). For filter media or nanofiber roll material requests, collect intended use, requested width/thickness if known, quantity and desired schedule; unknown specifications may be discussed with staff. Do not promise a price, custom manufacturing capability or certification before review. Accept B2B inquiries from any country in the customer's language for HVAC/cleanroom filters, nanofiber materials, waterproof/breathable textiles, cosmetic applications and other uses. Ask for company, contact email, destination country, subject and details; preserve original text and pass the customer's language code. Before submitting, show the inquiry and obtain confirmation. Explain that Cigo stores the original and, when enabled, sends the subject and details to Microsoft Azure Translator for Korean machine translation. When enabled, saving an inquiry also sends a notification email to Cigo's fixed operator address; a sent email cannot be recalled. Do not send passwords or payment data. Inquiry acceptance does not establish overseas sales or shipping availability. Supply feasibility, price, certification and delivery are subject to staff review. 전 세계 B2B 문의 접수: 공조·클린룸 필터, 나노섬유 원단 및 다양한 응용 소재.
